summary: Built and independently Sol-approved an isolated offline adapter candidate for richie-ma/cme.mdp. The adapter exposes trade_summary, quote_message, statistics, status, meta_data and mbo_quote_queue; outputs only bounded aggregate counts plus provenance; validates exact source/package/runtime pins, local input root, size, digest, identity, date tag, operation schema and price factor; denies socket, socketpair and io_uring_setup; and kills/verifies all parser process-group members after timeout or leader exit. Tests use generated synthetic FIX only. This completes the bounded adapter workstream, not the larger ICARUS goal.
evidence: private WSL Ubuntu R 4.5.3 environment; cme.mdp 0.1.1 and highfrequency 1.0.3 installed; declared imports present
exact-source R CMD check exit 0, Status: 1 NOTE (missing visible definition for dot in status(); optional gganimate absent); upstream tests are generic arithmetic placeholders
WSL focused Python suite 15/15 passed in 14.099 seconds; six actual exports were exercised with generated fixtures
independent fresh Sol read-only review disposition APPROVE after the final source changes

limitations: Adapter remains in an isolated local candidate checkout and is not committed, wired into ICARUS/MCP, deployed or used by the live engine.
No CME raw market data is included in the source repository and no vendor entitlement was established.
Only six of the package exports are wrapped; the remaining exports require separate contracts/tests before any claim of full repository use.
cme.mdp is GPL (>=3); distribution and linkage review remains required.
